race.title: Clonmel Oil Service Station Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: CEANNDANA is back on a handy mark over hurdles and may well capitalise. Zoffman and Hopeful Hero look the main dangers in a race that's likely to be tactical. CEANNDANA (IRE) ZOFFMAN (IRE) HOPEFUL HERO (IRE)
